concerns.text: The plan states 'simulate a synthetic dataset... OR aggregate data from separate randomized trials'. FR-001 requires *either* simulation or meta-analysis, but the plan doesn't explicitly demonstrate how each element of FR-001 is addressed in the plan. There’s no clear mapping to specific tasks/phases.
FR-002 requires preprocessing data to map categorical variables. The plan mentions 'data preparation' in Quickstart, but doesn't detail *how* this will be done or which tasks cover it.

FR-003 details the mixed-effects regression model. The plan mentions 'adaptive mixed-effects regression analysis', but lacks specifics on how the model selection (binomial/gaussian) will be automated based on data structure, or which tasks implement this.
FR-004 requires VIF calculation. The plan mentions it in US-2's acceptance criteria but doesn’t explicitly state *where* in the plan (which task/phase) this will be implemented.
FR-005 requires a sensitivity analysis with specific outlier thresholds. The plan mentions it in US-3, but doesn't map it to a concrete task or phase within the plan.
FR-006 mandates Bonferroni correction for post-hoc comparisons. The plan mentions this in US-3, but doesn't explicitly link it to a task or phase.
FR-007 requires generating a forest plot. The plan references this in US-3, but lacks explicit mapping to a specific task/phase for implementation.
SC-001 defines the measurement of the interaction term's p-value. While mentioned in US-2, there’s no clear indication *how* this will be measured or reported within the plan.
SC-002 requires measuring the stability of the interaction effect via sensitivity analysis. The plan mentions it in US-3, but doesn't explicitly state which task/phase will perform this measurement.
SC-003 requires measuring the precision of the effect estimate using confidence intervals. The plan mentions it in US-2, but doesn't map it to a specific task or phase for implementation.

SC-004 requires validating the risk-taking measure against source documentation/parameterization. The plan mentions this in US-1, but doesn't specify *how* this validation will be performed or documented within the plan.
The 'Complexity Tracking' section is empty and serves no purpose. Either populate it with relevant information or remove it to avoid unnecessary clutter.
